title: MECHANICAL ENGINEERING DYNAMICS
description: Introduces and applies concepts of kinematics and kinetics of particles and rigid bodies, with applications to mechanical systems of current interest to engineers.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (ENGR 103 or 103H) and (ENGR 211 or 211H) and (PH 211 or 211H).
A minimum grade of C is required in ENGR 103, ENGR 103H, ENGR 211, ENGR 211H, PH 211 and PH 211H.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
